M-MCP-COMMANDS.NAME: MCP tool catalog
M-MCP-COMMANDS.purpose: Single source of truth for the 21 MCP tools: names, descriptions, JSON schemas, argv mapping and argument validation.

export-TOOL_NAMES.PURPOSE: Names derived from TOOLS (exported for tests and docs).

type-ToolName.PURPOSE: Union of the 21 MCP tool names.

type-ToolDefinition.PURPOSE: name, description, inputSchema, rootArg, buildArgs, digestOutput.

fn-resolveProjectRoot.PURPOSE: Explicit arg, then MYGRACE_PROJECT_ROOT, then process.cwd().

fn-formatToolArgError.PURPOSE: Structured multi-field error text for agents.

fn-formatUnknownToolError.PURPOSE: Structured error for a name outside the catalog.

fn-buildToolCommand.PURPOSE: Tool name and args to mygrace argv (no binary, no PATH).

fn-compactLintOutput.PURPOSE: Compact lint digest for noisy MCP responses.

export-TOOLS.PURPOSE: Includes the ci gate tool (mygrace_ci) added in Wave 3.

contract.purpose: Single source of truth for the 21 MCP tools: names, descriptions, JSON schemas, argv mapping and argument validation.

param.name: argv
param.description: CLI arguments for the mapped command.

notes.note-1: Pure data and formatting: no MCP SDK import, no filesystem access, no process spawning, fully unit-testable.
notes.note-2: ListTools and CallTool share this one catalog, so schemas and mappings cannot drift.
notes.note-3: 25 tools including mygrace_trace, mygrace_impact, mygrace_next, mygrace_projects, mygrace_integrations, mygrace_diagram, mygrace_capsule_list, mygrace_capsule_run; DSH exposes them as mcp__mygrace__<tool>.
